scripts.build:web: pnpm -C crates/smooth-web/web install --silent && pnpm -C crates/smooth-web/web build
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm -C desktop install --silent && pnpm -C desktop dev
scripts.install:th: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:smooth-dolt:if-stale && pnpm install:smooth-dolt && cargo install --path crates/smooth-cli --features admin --force && cargo install --path crates/smooth-daemon --force && bash scripts/dev-link-th.sh
scripts.install:th:full: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:smooth-dolt && pnpm install:smooth-dolt && cargo install --path crates/smooth-cli --features admin --force && cargo install --path crates/smooth-daemon --force && bash scripts/dev-link-th.sh
scripts.install:th:brew: brew upgrade SmooAI/tools/th || brew install SmooAI/tools/th
scripts.dev:service:install: pnpm install:th && th service install && th service start
